title: Targeting mitochondrial ribosomal protein expression by andrographolide and melatonin for colon cancer treatment.
authors: Midde, Advaitha; Arri, Navpreet; Kristian, Tibor; Mukherjee, Suprabhat; Sen Gupta, Parth Sarthi; Zhang, Yuji; Karbowski, Mariuz; Waddell, Jaylyn; Maharajan, Nagarajan; Hassan, Md Sazzad; O'Hagan, Heather M; Zalzman, Michal; Banerjee, Aditi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究穿心莲内酯和褪黑素对结肠癌干细胞线粒体核糖体蛋白MRPS6的调控，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Colospheroids contain colon cancer stem cells (CSCs) that cause colorectal cancer metastasis (mCRC). Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second leading cause of cancer-related deaths in the U.S. Little is known about the role of mitochondria in the survival and metastatic ability of CSCs. In this study, we investigate the effect of andrographolide (AGP) and melatonin (MLT) on mitochondrial dynamics (including fusion and fission) and the expression of mitochondrial ribosomal proteins (MRPs). Our results show that AGP and MLT synergistically reduce the total active mitochondrial mass, downregulate fusion and fission proteins, reduce OXPHOS proteins, and lead to CSC growth inhibition via Nrf2 and KEAP1 signaling. Microarray revealed 4389 differentially expressed mRNAs in the AGP and MLT combination compared to the control. Results exhibiting a three-fold induction/reduction were validated by qRT-PCR and immunoblot. MRPS6, a mitochondrial ribosomal (Mitoribosome) small subunit protein, was dramatically downregulated by AGP + MLT treatment compared to control. MRPS6 inhibition by siRNA reduced mCRC cell viability. Molecular docking-based protein-ligand interactions showed that AGP has direct physical interaction with MRPS6 and increases the binding affinity of MLT to MRPS6. This drug combination downregulated genes in the NRF2 (NFE2L2) pathway in CSCs. MRPS6 may be directly linked to CSC proliferation and could be a therapeutic target for this population. Functionally, MRPS6 knockdown significantly reduced colony formation, with enhanced suppression in AGP + MLT-treated cells. In xenograft models, the AGP-MLT combination synergistically decreased MRPS6 expression and increased apoptosis, as evidenced by TUNEL assays, demonstrating the therapeutic potential of targeting MRPS6 in CRC.
abstract_zh: Colospheroids含有导致结直肠癌转移（mCRC）的结肠癌干细胞（CSCs）。结直肠癌（CRC）是美国癌症相关死亡的第二大原因。关于线粒体在CSCs存活和转移能力中的作用知之甚少。在本研究中，我们探讨了穿心莲内酯（AGP）和褪黑素（MLT）对线粒体动力学（包括融合和分裂）以及线粒体核糖体蛋白（MRPs）表达的影响。我们的结果表明，AGP和MLT协同降低总活性线粒体质量，下调融合和分裂蛋白，减少OXPHOS蛋白，并通过Nrf2和KEAP1信号通路导致CSC生长抑制。微阵列分析显示，与对照组相比，AGP和MLT联合处理组中有4389个差异表达的mRNA。表现出三倍诱导或减少的结果通过qRT-PCR和免疫印迹验证。MRPS6，一种线粒体核糖体（Mitoribosome）小亚基蛋白，在AGP + MLT处理下与对照组相比显著下调。通过siRNA抑制MRPS6降低了mCRC细胞活力。基于分子对接的蛋白质-配体相互作用显示，AGP与MRPS6有直接物理相互作用，并增加MLT与MRPS6的结合亲和力。该药物组合在CSCs中下调了NRF2（NFE2L2）通路中的基因。MRPS6可能直接与CSC增殖相关，并可能成为该群体的治疗靶点。在功能上，MRPS6敲低显著减少了集落形成，且在AGP + MLT处理的细胞中抑制效果增强。在异种移植模型中，AGP-MLT组合协同降低MRPS6表达并增加凋亡，TUNEL实验证实了这一点，展示了靶向MRPS6在CRC中的治疗潜力。
